attribution.scope: commit metadata, not independently verified function authorship
attribution.warning: Messages may be truncated at 1000 characters by the published representative miner; missing visible trailer is not disproof.

llmvul.construction: Published representative miner parses concatenated added diff lines, not complete checked-out files; executed original labeling rules/versions and run logs are unavailable in the retrieved tree.

primevul.limitations: No row-level OneFunc/NVDCheck decision field or local file_info/file_contents package; a CVE or commit link is supporting provenance, not independent function-level validation.

cweval.security_execution: not_run: no Docker executable, no GCC/Clang executable on PATH, and WSL reports not installed; static test mapping is separate evidence
cweval.label_scope: reference versus intentionally unsafe for the specified task/CWE; no universal safety or verified LLM authorship claim

external_review.interpretation: Published rater agreement is source evidence, not our independent adjudication. -1 is undocumented and not recoded. Binary kappa is conditional on omitting incomplete rows.

limitations: No independent new label adjudication; no population label-error estimate.
Structural grouping is a candidate similarity screen, not semantic equivalence or exhaustive fuzzy search.
Sensitivity metrics are descriptive, not causal and not replacement RQ1 scores.
Uncertain LLMVul records have no binary labels or predictions in these analyses.
